observations.code_quote: The app captures the current window before the form opens. The screenshot can be reviewed and stays off until selected. People can attach up to two images with **Attach images** or paste them into the message. Both methods use the same image checks and limit. Image previews open after attachment, and images can be removed before sending. Text paste still works. If another image is still loading, the form asks the user to wait and paste again. Files without a MIME type use their image signature; files with an incorrect or unsupported format are rejected. Recent app logs can be reviewed while they stay off, and are sent only when selected.
